description: Training a Workforce to Bring Nature-based Solutions into Every Project is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Protectores de Cuencas, Inc.. An ecosystem restoration nonprofit, Protectores de Cuencas, Inc., is training workers in the skilled trades to implement nature-based solutions as part of their workflows on every project, regardless of whether projects are publicly or privately funded or specifically focused on ecosystem restoration and management. Coverage: Puerto Rico & U.S. Virgin Islands (2025). The toolkit gives Puerto Rico & U.S. Virgin Islands as the location, 2025 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
